content.title: Why Moderna Stock Is Dropping After Good News
content.summary: Moderna  offered investors a glimpse at its upcoming earnings report as it pre-announced revenue above the midpoint of its prior guidance range.  Presenting at the annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference on Monday, Moderna said it expects 2025 revenue of roughly $1.9 billion, $100 million above the midpoint of the range communicated on the company’s third-quarter earnings call.  The company still expects revenue growth of up to 10% in 2026, and reiterated that it expects non-adjusted operating expenses to decline to $4.9 billion from a range of $5 billion to $5.2 billion in 2025.
